description: This Java interface defines a generic adapter for handling query command responses within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It specifies default behaviors such as criteria and actions applicable to such responses.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Provides the set of criteria, defaulting to COMMANDS, for the adapter's focus.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Provides the set of actions, defaulting to RETRIEVE, relevant to the adapter.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter is intended for responses, returning true by default.
